run_prune_and_finetune: run the PruneAndFinetune class to prune and finetune an action agent using SAC on a replay buffer
run_sac_finetuning: run SAC finetuning on an action agent and q agent with entropy regularization and target network updates
create_prune_and_finetune: create a PruneAndFinetune instance with config params for SAC-based pruning and finetuning of RL agents
review_prune_and_finetune_run: review the PruneAndFinetune run method that adds a filter and executes SAC finetuning on agents
refactor_run_sac: refactor the run_sac method to customize optimizer configuration, gradient clipping, or target network update frequency
